title: Admin frame runs four separate 60s pollers per tab, with eleven count queries in one of them
rootCause: Sidebar polls three endpoints and each of two mounted bells polls notifications every 60s; admin-badges runs 11 count:'exact' queries; each call also passes middleware.
evidence: Code read; about 480 invocations per tab-hour.
fix: One AdminBadgesContext poller at 120s plus throttled focus and route refresh; admin_badge_counts() SQL function returns 14 counts (migration 20261026090000, staging applied) with fallback.
risk: Badges can lag up to 2 minutes without navigation.

title: CRM person detail downloads the whole payment_installments table and shows the wrong scholarship
rootCause: Unfiltered select('*') on payment_installments filtered in JS; scholarship_applications unfiltered limit(10) then matched by lead_profile_id.
impact: Payload grows with the business; most users showed no scholarship.
fix: Filter both in SQL by lead_profile_id; explicit JOURNEY_COLUMNS for joins.
risk: Screens reading new columns must add them to JOURNEY_COLUMNS.
expected: Detail payload limited to the person; correct scholarship.

title: Students hub sends the whole cohort and filters in the browser; listing silently capped at 1,000
rootCause: limit(5000) is capped at 1,000 by PostgREST; grid in client mode.
evidence: Code read; prod has 155 architecture students today.
impact: Grows linearly; reconcile join ran on every mount.
fix: Server pagination, sort and filter (50 per page), fetchAllRows paging, reconcile on demand.
risk: Select-all covers one page; each filter change is a request.

title: Financial, onboarding, revenue and dashboard numbers are summed in JS and truncated at 1,000 rows
rootCause: Sequential unbounded reads aggregated in JS.
evidence: Prod row counts (read-only): 1,150 onboarding sessions and 3,762 responses, so the old analytics undercounted.
fix: SQL functions financial_dashboard_summary, onboarding_analytics, revenue_by_year, dashboard_stats with fallbacks; verified against synthetic data on staging.
risk: Migration must actually apply (db push continue-on-error).
expected: One RPC per dashboard; correct totals.

title: College lists, outreach list and student-matches load whole tables; direct-enrollment GET writes
rootCause: No limit or offset; JS matching of all emails; a write on every GET; N+1 in /api/leads.
fix: limit/offset/search with a shared server-searched picker; pagination and narrow columns; SQL email match; expiry moved to the identity-sweep cron; one .in() query.
risk: Expired-link filter may lag up to a day.
